black_first: Shared NoteOns in all five nodes before plant contact; no added plant effect perceived.
plant_first: EC5 produces NoteOns before black in 2 of 3 repetitions; adding black produces shared NoteOns in all three.
rest_or_recovery_failure: EC5 first two plant-first release windows retain MIDI activity; inspect baseline freeze, return-to-rest and detector reset handling before firmware design.
causal_limit: Sequential trials with baseline drift do not isolate contact order as the sole cause.
